scope: Current locally built UI and real Chromium/Pyodide worker, offline after startup. One cold conditional literal Pazy frozen-influence steady wall-root equilibrium at 5 degrees/56 m/s/120 requested intervals, plus saved-project restoration without recalculation. This one browser equilibrium is separate from the native curve sweep. No dynamics, eigenmodes, time integration or hosted release.
tolerance_basis: Same source, explicit mesh and physical conditions across native and WASM. Compare every native result field except the named counters and equivalent panel-settings representation.
declared_equivalences: Scalar nominal panel count and {default:count,beams:{}} select the same cosine discretization; all actual mesh geometry and physical state are compared.
Empty circulation_modes and an explicit zero per lifting beam both select pointwise circulation.
execution_counter_policy: Accepted continuation_steps and evaluation counts are recorded separately, not constrained to match. The requested continuation input is four, while the unchanged solver may adapt its load steps. All physical result numbers retain the strict comparison gate.
